independent_method: No pipeline helpers imported. Statistics reconstructed from CSV; identity, latent arrays and all record hashes checked; all 28 census predicates independently reconstructed from trace/upstream/saved-step measurement primitives, including unknown and provenance gating. Geometry measurements themselves are not rerun.

code.manual_review: Full-module AST checked: method enums extend explicitly; inference additionally clears init_curve_feedback_checkpoint for strict full-load and verifies feedback identity. All numeric inference, raw metric, post worker, validity, sampling and timeout computations are unchanged.

fit_only.source_step_hash_limitation: Checks protect assets since this evaluation's reuse snapshot, not against unrecorded historical mutations.

optimized.source_step_hash_limitation: Checks protect assets since this evaluation's reuse snapshot, not against unrecorded historical mutations.

stratified_failure_mechanisms.interpretation: Post-hoc descriptive stratification, not a preregistered causal test; full evaluation metrics and the dynamically derived main failure denominator are unchanged. Exact adjacency checks only face-pair adjacency, not complete B-Rep topology or boundary geometry.
